review_evidence: Complete primary inventory covers 40 Lean files; 28 files contain 278 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.
The source formalizes the Yjs sequence-integration algorithm, causal networks, ordering invariants, operation commutativity, and replica convergence.

DiffTestRunner and the root aggregator remain source-local executable/navigation material adjacent to the verified algorithm; tests are not a hard-filter class and no lossless exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete Lean-Yjs verification unit.

review_evidence: grep -c -E '\b(theorem|lemma|def|structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom)\b' over the four files gave: LeanYjs/Order/NoCrossOrigin.lean=1, LeanYjs/Order/ItemSetInvariant.lean=11, LeanYjs/Algorithm/Insert/Basic.lean=38, LeanYjs/Algorithm/Invariant/Basic.lean=12.

Read LeanYjs/Order/NoCrossOrigin.lean completely (149 lines): it is one `theorem no_cross_origin` with a strong-induction proof over `YjsItem` size, case-splitting on `yjs_lt'_cases` and using lemmas like `yjs_leq_p_trans`, `yjs_lt_asymm`, `OriginReachable` — a real, nontrivial CRDT ordering proof, not a stub.
Read the head of LeanYjs/Algorithm/Insert/Basic.lean: defines `IntegrateInput` structure and `IntegrateInput.toItem`, the CRDT insert-position resolution logic.
Read the head of LeanYjs/Algorithm/Invariant/Basic.lean: defines `ArrSet`, `ArrSetClosed`, and proves `arr_set_closed_push` by induction.

Read the head of LeanYjs/Order/ItemSetInvariant.lean: defines the `ItemSetInvariant` structure (origin_not_leq, origins_adjacent_in_reachable, id_unique) and two `@[simp] theorem`s (`origin_p_valid`, `right_origin_p_valid`).
summary: Read all four files of the unit. grep -c for declaration keywords gave Insert/Basic.lean=38, Invariant/Basic.lean=12, ItemSetInvariant.lean=11 over normal-sized files, and NoCrossOrigin.lean=1 despite being 149 lines, so I read NoCrossOrigin.lean completely to check the low count was not a sign of junk: it is a single large theorem (`no_cross_origin`) proved by one long, genuinely structured tactic proof (strong induction on `x.size + y.size`, case splits on `yjs_lt'_cases`), which explains the single keyword hit. The other three files are structures/defs/theorems for the Yjs CRDT integrate algorithm and its ordering invariants. All four hold real formal mathematical content.
